title: ROCIs Tasks: To-Do & Planner
shortDescription: To-do list, daily planner and calendar in one, with home screen widgets.
fullDescription:
ROCIs Tasks is a to-do list and daily planner that puts your tasks and your calendar on one screen. Plan your workday, track personal goals or keep a shopping list, and see everything due today at a glance.

Add a task in seconds, check it off from your home screen widget, and see your meetings right next to your to-dos. No switching between a task app and a calendar app.

✨ What you can do ✨

✅ To-do lists that stay simple: create tasks, add subtasks, set priorities (High, Medium, Low) and due dates, and sort everything into categories.

⚡ Quick add: type "Finish report tomorrow 3pm" and the task is scheduled for you.

🔁 Recurring tasks and reminders: daily, weekly or custom repeats, with reminders so nothing slips.

📅 Calendar planner: events from your phone's calendar appear next to your tasks on a monthly calendar with your daily agenda. Plan your whole day in one place.

📱 Home screen widgets: month calendar, today's agenda, Up Next and a Kanban board widget. Check off tasks right from your home screen.

🗂️ Kanban board: drag tasks between columns to track progress on projects.

☁️ Sync and offline mode: your tasks sync across devices in real time and work offline, then sync again when you reconnect.

🎨 Clean design: dark mode, AMOLED black theme and Material You colors.

🌐 Available in 8 languages, including right-to-left layouts.

Download ROCIs Tasks and plan your day with one to-do list and calendar.
